description: Soft-revoke a share token minted via `share_file`. The public `/share/files/<token>` URL stops resolving immediately. Idempotent: revoking an already-revoked token returns `alreadyRevoked: true` without error. Editor role required.

token_id.description: The `token_id` returned by `share_file` (NOT the token in the `url`).

name: revoke_file_share
